selection.description: Quota 1 ranks eligible applicants by their converted upper-secondary grade average. SEA describes this route for EU/EEA citizens; other applicant groups should confirm their assessment route.
Quota 2 considers documented qualifications and a motivation letter on SEA's form; eligible applicants are also assessed in quota 1. The weighting of quota 2 factors is not published.

requirements.label: An IB Diploma, or DP Course Results with at least 18 points, grade 3 in all six subjects and three of them at HL

officialWording.text: IB-elever uden IB Diploma, men med mindst 18 point (Diploma Programme (DP) Course Results), har adgang til videregående uddannelser i Danmark på lige vilkår med ansøgere med den 2-årige hf-eksamen uden overbygning. Det kræver, at alle 6 IB-fag (3 HL-fag og 3 SL- eller 4 HL-fag og 2 SL-fag) er bestået med mindst karakteren 3. Det betyder, at de har adgang til at søge optagelse på erhvervsakademi- og professionsbacheloruddannelser gennem kvote 1 og 2.

requirements.note: The rule is national, not this institution's. The Danish Agency for Higher Education and Science treats DP Course Results of at least 18 points, with grade 3 or more in all six subjects and three at HL, like a two-year hf without overbygning, which gives access to erhvervsakademi and professionsbachelor programmes through quota 1 and quota 2. This is an erhvervsakademiuddannelse (AP degree), which the Agency names directly. The institution's own page names the IB but says nothing about Course Results, so a Course candidate should confirm with admissions in writing. The award does not waive the subject requirements below.

requirements.label: English at B level
requirements.subject: English
requirements.note: English B is required; the IB exemption SEA publishes is from documenting English with a test, not from English B. SEA: "All applicants holding a foreign entrance examination must document their English qualifications, and English tests must be submitted" … "Applicants holding Nordic and German entrance exams, an International Baccalaureate exam or applicants who have English as their native language are exempt from the requirement." (s-e-a.dk, read 25 Sep 2026.)

requirements.label: English documented with a test (applicants with a foreign entrance examination)
requirements.openQuestion: SEA exempts "an International Baccalaureate exam"; whether that includes DP Course Results is not published. Ask SEA before you rely on it.
requirements.note: SEA: "All applicants holding a foreign entrance examination must document their English qualifications, and English tests must be submitted" … "Applicants holding Nordic and German entrance exams, an International Baccalaureate exam or applicants who have English as their native language are exempt from the requirement." Met by the full IB Diploma; whether the exemption reaches DP Course Results is not published. For applicants who need a test, the current programme page lists IELTS 6.5, TOEFL internet-based 94 or paper-based 560, Cambridge Proficiency or Advanced, Oxford Placement B2 with 75 in each part, or CEFR B2/C1; the test must be under two years old. Confirm the accepted sitting and score scale with SEA.

requirements.label: Quota 1: ranked on the converted upper-secondary grade average; SEA describes this route for EU/EEA citizens.
Quota 2: documented other qualifications and a motivation letter on SEA's form; SEA does not publish factor weights.

officialRequirementsText.text: Notice: You must have passed maths at B level and english at B level if you want the english course. [...] Mathematic B (required for Computer Science). Mathematic B-level is equivalent to 250 full teaching hours (60 minutes per hour).

notes: An AP degree is a short-cycle qualification (EQF level 5), not a bachelor's degree.
The main IB application deadline remains the national March route; the programme-page 5 July 2027 quota 1 headline is not the IB application deadline.

SEA's FAQ and full-degree guide disagree on document deadlines. The guide permits a current transcript before graduation and asks applicants receiving diplomas after its deadline to contact SEA. Final May-session IB results require an agreed arrangement; no separate predicted-grade deadline or automatic late-results acceptance is published.
SEA's linked fee table is labelled 2024/2027; its continuing applicability to autumn 2027 is unconfirmed. Non-EU status alone does not rule out a residence-based tuition exemption.

tuition.note: EU/EEA and Swiss students are exempt. Other residence-based exemptions are described in the full-degree guide.

cost.priceYear: Published tariff labelled 2024/2027; autumn 2027 validity unconfirmed
